response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile staff-level engineer with strong full-stack, cloud, and developer-tooling credentials, and his recent work on MCP code generators and agentic-workflow frameworks is directly relevant. However, the role requires 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, and his hands-on GenAI experience appears limited to roughly the last year. There is no demonstrated experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, or leading customer-facing technical discovery, and Python is notably absent from his skill set. He could be worth a conversation if the AI-experience bar is flexible, but on paper he falls well short of the core requirements.
strengths: Current hands-on experience with MCP servers and agentic-workflow infrastructure
Strong TypeScript/Node.js production experience with AWS (CDK) and Kubernetes
Staff-level breadth across systems, testing culture, mentoring, and public workshops/talks
concerns: Only ~1 year of GenAI/agentic work vs. required 8+ years of AI solution development
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation pipelines, or data-pipeline work for AI
No demonstrated customer-facing technical discovery or forward-deployed/consulting experience; Python not listed

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG/vector DB and enterprise discovery experience
